found.quote: Plagiarism may, therefore, include: a. the use of another person’s material without reference or acknowledgement b. the use of material produced by generative artificial intelligence (GAI) without the specific permission of the tutor/lecturer
where permission to use GAI has been granted, the use of material produced by GAI must be referenced or acknowledged
Plagiarism: unacknowledged incorporation in a student’s work either in an examination or assessment of material derived from the work (published or unpublished) of another.
Other factors will be considered as well as the proportion of the assessment which has been plagiarised.
found.anchor: INDICATIVE PENALTY IN CASES OF PLAGIARISM (TAUGHT PROVISION)
